control.title: Outsourcing register, sub-contracting and exit plans
control.description: Keep a register of all outsourcing arrangements with materiality and criticality, approve sub-contracting in advance, and keep a tested exit plan for each material arrangement so data can be returned or destroyed and the service moved without disruption.

implementation_notes: Vendors are tiered and assessed before onboarding and annually.
evidence_hint: Outsourcing register, materiality assessments, sub-contractor approvals, exit plans.
acceptance_criteria: A register lists outsourcing arrangements with materiality or criticality and an owner
Sub-contracting by material providers was approved in advance
Material arrangements have a documented exit plan

requirements.title: Vendor risk and independent assurance
requirements.guidance: Manage vendor risk under the outsourcing framework, protect against infiltration from vendor environments, and get independent assurance for vendors in critical processes.
